method: A tense is cross-checked only when every generated form is present in the Lexique pilot. Futur/conditionnel variants are accepted when one complete candidate array matches. For passé composé with avoir, only the masculine-singular participle is generated and checked; with être, all four agreement forms are generated and checked. Verbs absent from the 300-lemma pilot are not cross-checkable and remain unsupported for that tense.
